Rulebook / ADR Ref: Hirer completes 3 steps; questFundingTotal locked in escrow from spendingBalanceSatang; status becomes QUEST_OPEN
Specification & Requirement Summary: Cannot publish if spending balance < questFundingTotal; cannot create with past dueAt

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Single: first worker joins directly -> QUEST_ASSIGNED. Group: workers join directly until headcount reached.
Specification & Requirement Summary: No candidate application step allowed; cannot join after headcount full or quest closed

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Candidates apply individually or in teams; Hirer manually reviews and selects winning roster
Specification & Requirement Summary: Hirer selection rejects all other candidates/teams in the same transaction; no partial team selection

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Server generates 24h code for GROUP + CANDIDATE; team leader can regenerate code; auto-disbands if all leave
Specification & Requirement Summary: Cannot submit team before exact headcount; cannot edit members after team submitted; code invalid after 24h

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Required starter can press Start Work ONLY between startTime and dueAt. Single: worker. Group Candidate: team leader.
Specification & Requirement Summary: Pressing before startTime or after dueAt is blocked; missing Start Work by dueAt fails quest

Rulebook / ADR Ref: At startTime, underfilled FCFS: Hirer has 10 min to proceed or cancel. If proceed, all workers have 10 min to consent.
Specification & Requirement Summary: Any timeout or rejection cancels quest with 100% refund; reward pool split equally between consented workers

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Hirer can edit quest conditions in QUEST_ASSIGNED; all assigned workers must vote within 10 minutes
Specification & Requirement Summary: If any worker rejects or 10m expires, condition reverts to original; quest does not cancel

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Worker uploads 1-5 files/images and optional summary note before dueAt; draft saved locally during entry
Specification & Requirement Summary: Cannot submit 0 files when proofRequired=true; cannot submit > 5 files; cannot submit after dueAt

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Hirer reviews proof; if Hirer does not act within 24h, backend automatically triggers PROOF_APPROVED
Specification & Requirement Summary: Hirer rejection requires non-empty reason; rejection triggers QUEST_FAILED and Admin Review Item

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Hirer cancels during QUEST_OPEN: 100% refund of Quest Escrow back to Hirer spendingBalanceSatang
Specification & Requirement Summary: No worker penalty; all active candidate inquiries closed immediately

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Hirer cancels during QUEST_ASSIGNED: 20% of worker reward pool paid to active workers, 80% + platform fee to Hirer
Specification & Requirement Summary: Assigned workers compensated for reservation; quest transitions to QUEST_CANCELLED

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Hirer cancels during QUEST_IN_PROGRESS: 100% worker reward paid to workers, platform fee kept; Hirer gets 0 refund
Specification & Requirement Summary: Prevents work exploitation; active workers receive full reward

Rulebook / ADR Ref: Hirer and Worker can submit reciprocal rating & review within 7 days of QUEST_COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED
Specification & Requirement Summary: Reviews locked after 7 days; rating score updates public profile reputation aggregate asynchronously

Item / Flow Name: All internal currency stored as 32-bit integer satang (1 THB = 100 satang)
Specification & Requirement Summary: Strictly non-negative integer math; floating-point money strictly prohibited

Item / Flow Name: 4 distinct compartments: Spending, Earnings, Funding Reserved, Reserved for Payouts
Specification & Requirement Summary: Total wallet capacity capped at 2,000,000,000 Satang (฿20,000,000); transactions exceeding cap fail closed

Item / Flow Name: Member generates PromptPay QR payload; webhook or poll confirms receipt
Specification & Requirement Summary: Double-entry credit to spendingBalanceSatang upon external payment clearing

Item / Flow Name: Publishing quest locks questFundingTotal (worker rewards + platform fee) in escrow
Specification & Requirement Summary: Debits spendingBalanceSatang, credits fundingReservedSatang in single transaction

Item / Flow Name: Instant conversion of earningsBalanceSatang to spendingBalanceSatang
Specification & Requirement Summary: Debits earningsBalanceSatang, credits spendingBalanceSatang; zero platform fee

Item / Flow Name: Worker requests withdrawal of earningsBalanceSatang to verified bank/PromptPay
Specification & Requirement Summary: Debits earningsBalanceSatang, credits reservedForPayoutsSatang until Admin approval

Item / Flow Name: Wallet statuses: ACTIVE, FROZEN, SUSPENDED, CLOSED
Specification & Requirement Summary: FROZEN/SUSPENDED blocks new commitments (top-up, publish, join); active escrow runs to completion

Item / Flow Name: Strictly 2 members: Hirer + 1 Prospective Worker. Active only during QUEST_OPEN.
Specification & Requirement Summary: Zero KU Bot system messages allowed; human-to-human Q&A only

Item / Flow Name: Hirer + all current Active Workers. Opened upon first ASSIGNMENT_ACTIVE.
Specification & Requirement Summary: Official KU Bot posts immutable events (start work, proof submitted, deadline alert, completion)

Item / Flow Name: Cooldown triggers after 5 messages in 5 seconds window
Specification & Requirement Summary: UI displays cooldown counter (e.g. "Wait 4s") and preserves draft input text without wiping

Item / Flow Name: Any chat message can be reported for harassment or policy violation
Specification & Requirement Summary: Generates Admin Evidence Reference; Admin can inspect reported thread via dispute portal

Item / Flow Name: All asynchronous server queries & mutations managed by TanStack Query v5
Specification & Requirement Summary: No manual useEffect data fetching; no custom fetching cache in React Context

Item / Flow Name: Domain client state managed by lightweight Zustand stores
Specification & Requirement Summary: Zero application-owned React Context for mutable app state (ADR-0012)

Item / Flow Name: Pure domain reducers hosted by Zustand vanilla or pure functions
Specification & Requirement Summary: No business logic inside React UI components

Item / Flow Name: Explicit storage adapters: SecureStore for session, AsyncStorage for drafts/prefs
Specification & Requirement Summary: No sensitive auth tokens or session cookies in unencrypted AsyncStorage

Item / Flow Name: WebSocket connections must supply Origin: kuquestmobile:// and Cookie
Specification & Requirement Summary: Direct new WebSocket() without Origin causes 4403 rejection on staging backend

Item / Flow Name: NativeWind v4 with strict semantic ramp tokens (ku-primary, ku-surface, etc.)
Specification & Requirement Summary: Workspace dynamic theme: Hirer (sage) vs Worker (emerald) swaps seamlessly

Item / Flow Name: Be Vietnam Pro font family; responsive layout without hardcoded fixed heights
Specification & Requirement Summary: Android fontScale 1.3+ support: text wraps cleanly without clipping or truncation

Item / Flow Name: All interactive touch targets must be at least 44x44pt (Apple HIG / Android Material)
Specification & Requirement Summary: Buttons, tab items, back arrows, list row items include hitSlop or min dimensions

Item / Flow Name: All controls require accessible labels, roles, and hint where state is not obvious
Specification & Requirement Summary: accessibilityRole (button, tab, header), accessibilityState (selected, disabled)

Item / Flow Name: All screens respect react-native-safe-area-context edge insets
Specification & Requirement Summary: Header avoids status bar and Dynamic Island; footer avoids home indicator bar
